name: Laca
style: Water Blast · playful Water evolutions and opportunistic tempo

dialogue.intro: ¡No puede ser! Look who finally came back. Come here, idiot. You still owe me a rematch from when we were kids.
dialogue.repeat: There you are! I was starting to think you forgot our extremely important agreement to cause harmless trouble together.
dialogue.flirt: Che, we've known each other forever. If I were flirting, you'd know. ...Okay, yes, I'm flirting.
dialogue.duelWin: Oh, that was actually clever. Don't look so proud; I'm already planning the rematch.
dialogue.duelLose: Ha! Classic Laca victory. You can buy the ice cream. Those are the rules I just invented.
talk: Remember the summer we tried to invent a secret handshake? We got bored halfway through and called it perfect.
My whistle is for work. My judgmental look? That's free, and you have lifetime access.
The red swimsuit's basically my uniform. The real challenge is keeping sand out of my deck sleeves.
If I suddenly stop joking near the water, it's because I'm working. You know the difference.
I still remember your first Pokémon deck. The strategy was 'hope the opponent feels bad for me.'
This morning I taught a nervous swimmer how to float. Best part of my shift, no contest.
You've been away long enough that I'm claiming all future rematches as overdue childhood debts.
I can stay in the water all day. Put me in a long planning meeting and I last six minutes.
You know I trust you, right? I wouldn't ask just anyone to tell me when I'm being ridiculous.
I bought new sunglasses. They're impractical, dramatic, and therefore a sound financial decision.
A stranger asks if I'm flirting and I say no. You ask and I make you figure it out.
Don't start with the innocent face. I've known you since you tried to trade a common for my favorite rare.
hangouts: Laca and you compare snacks on the park bench, arguing over a ranking the two of you invented at age ten.
After her lifeguard shift, Laca drags you into an entirely unnecessary challenge to build the best deck name.
Laca shows you two new outfits and insists you give her an opinion more useful than 'they're both fine.'
You and Laca revisit the arcade cabinet you used to play together, and she immediately accuses it of cheating.
A calm evening walk turns into a contest to remember the most embarrassing stories from your childhood.
Laca stretches after swimming and talks through a difficult day at work, glad she doesn't have to act cheerful around you.
At the café, Laca steals one fry, offers half her dessert in return, and calls it a fair trade.
You help her sort rescue-kit supplies. Laca turns the inventory into an absurdly serious competition.

appearance.silhouette: Adult Argentine Latina, 20, 167 cm, slim and naturally curvy, athletic enough to work as a lifeguard; realistic modest proportions without exaggeration.
appearance.palette: Deep dark brown hair, warm olive-tan skin, red rescue swimwear, black casual top, light-blue denim, sunlit gold accents.
appearance.hair: Very long dark brown to near-black hair, often worn loose off duty and tied back safely while on duty.
appearance.eyes: Almond-shaped dark brown eyes, strong shaped brows, unusually long curled eyelashes, full natural lips.
appearance.details: Small hoop earrings, optional whistle and rescue buoy at work, practical sun protection; familiar mischievous smile.
appearance.expressions: Teasing smirk, genuine laughter, mock-indignant pout, concentration while working, surprised blush when friendship turns romantic, unguarded affectionate smile.
outfits: On-duty: sporty Baywatch-inspired red two-piece lifeguard swimsuit with secure appropriate coverage, whistle and rescue buoy; used most waterfront mornings.
Off-duty: approved fitted black top with light-wash blue jeans and simple earrings.
Casual after swimming: sensible beach wrap, towel or light coverup when not on active duty.
Story-specific outfit variations: SFW casual/swimwear options shown openly to a trusted childhood friend.
appearance.renderNotes: Neo Campus anime/JRPG clean cel shading, consistent approved face and lashes across looks, adult and self-assured. On-duty scenes use credible safety equipment and movement. No voyeur camera, accidental exposure, nudity, or uninvited physical contact. Transparent single-character VN portrait. Outfit art variants can be installed later.
